CustomField.description: Auto-populated from the related Opportunity's Amount at Case creation, via Case_Field_Mapping__c / CaseFieldMappingEngine. Case Fields sheet row "Total Annual Amount (TAA)" - the sheet's own cited source field doesn't exist; per explicit direction this copies Opportunity.Amount instead. Note: Opportunity already has a same-named Eligible_Annual_Amount__c field for a related but distinct reporting/incentive purpose - not the source used here.
CustomField.label: Eligible Annual Amount
